input.summary: Add infringement remedies (procure/modify/replace, else refund) and carve M&I's indemnity out of the 3-month liability cap with a 3x annual fees super-cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] M&I's indemnity is presently capped at three months' payments by § 13.4, which is well below our fallback super-cap of 3x annual fees, and there is no continuity remedy for an infringement claim. We have added procure/modify/replace with a fee refund fallback, and carved the § 14.2(B) indemnity out of § 13.4 at 3x annual fees.

ops.text: C. Infringement Remedies. If a claim described in clause (i) of Section 14.2(B) is made, M&I shall procure for Customer the right to continue using the affected Services or software, or modify or replace it so that it is non-infringing. If none of those remedies is available, M&I shall refund to Customer the fees paid for the affected Services or software.

ops.oldText: M&I's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed payments made to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the three (3) months prior to the event.
ops.newText: M&I's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed payments made to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the three (3) months prior to the event, except that M&I's liability for its indemnification obligations under Section 14.2(B) shall not exceed three (3) times the annual fees paid to M&I by Customer under this Agreement.
